source: • 你伸手在空中勾勒出一个防护印记，以令自己在下一回合结束前对武器攻击造成的钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害具有抗性。
target: • You extend your hand and trace a protective sigil in the air, giving yourself resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks until the end of your next turn.
note: M4, 2014 Blade Ward: retained weapon-attack restriction, all three damage types, and the end of the next turn; no other edition's mechanics added.

source: • 你触碰一个自愿的生物。在法术终止前，目标可以选择在一次属性检定时额外掷一粒d4，并将所得数值加入检定结果中。它可以在进行属性检定之前或之后掷骰。法术随后即终止。
target: • You touch a willing creature. Before the spell ends, the target can choose to roll an extra d4 for one ability check and add the number rolled to the check's result. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.
note: M16, 2014 Guidance: one ability check, optional d4, before-or-after timing and subsequent spell ending all retained.

source: • 你触碰一个自愿的生物。在法术终止前，目标可以选择在一次豁免检定时额外掷一粒d4，并将所得数值加入检定结果中。他可以在进行豁免检定之前或之后掷骰。法术随后即终止。
target: • You touch a willing creature. Before the spell ends, the target can choose to roll an extra d4 for one saving throw and add the number rolled to the save's result. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The spell then ends.
note: M33, 2014 Resistance: retained the saving-throw use, optional d4, before-or-after timing and spell ending; did not reuse the Guidance check type.

source: • 你触碰一个生命值为0的活体生物，使该生物的伤势立刻稳定下来。该法术对不死生物和构装生物无效。
target: • You touch a living creature with 0 hit points, immediately stabilizing it. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.
note: M39, 2014 Spare the Dying: touch, living target at 0 hit points and both creature-type exclusions retained; no healing added.

source: • 你伸出手并以手指指向施法距离内的一个生物，并以魔力刹那间看穿目标的防御。如果该法术还未终止，则你在自己的下一回合里，对该目标发动的第一次攻击检定具有优势。
target: • You extend your hand and point a finger at a creature within range, using magic to gain a momentary insight into its defenses. If the spell has not ended, you have advantage on the first attack roll you make against that target during your next turn.
note: M45, 2014 True Strike: retained next-turn timing, first attack roll against that target, and the spell-still-active condition. No 2024 attack or damage effect substituted.

source: • 你的祈祷赋予你神圣的光芒。在法术持续时间结束前，你的武器攻击命中时将造成额外1d4点光耀伤害。
target: • Your prayer imbues you with holy radiance. Until the spell's duration ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on a hit.
note: M75, 2014 Divine Favor: weapon attacks, hit requirement, duration and 1d4 Radiant damage retained.

source: • 此法术让你以惊人的步速移动。你在施展该法术时可以执行一次“疾走 Dash ”动作。其后直至法术终止前的每个自己回合，你能以一个附赠动作执行“疾走 Dash ”动作。
target: • This spell lets you move at an astonishing pace. When you cast it, you can take the Dash action. On each of your turns thereafter until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.
note: M79, 2014 Expeditious Retreat: Dash on casting and a Bonus Action Dash on each subsequent turn are distinct; retained both permissions.

source:
• 你从死灵法术中获得了额外的生命力。在法术持续时间内，你获得1d4+4的临时生命值。
• 升环施法效应：使用2环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比1环高一环，其给予的临时生命值就增加5。
target:
• You draw extra vitality from necromantic magic. For the duration, you gain 1d4+4 Temporary Hit Points.
• Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the Temporary Hit Points it grants increase by 5 for each slot level above 1.
note: M81, 2014 False Life: retained 1d4+4, the duration, level-2 threshold and 5-per-level-above-1 increase; both source bullets translated in full.

source: • 你触碰一个自愿生物，在法术持续时间内，他的先攻掷骰中可以加入一个额外的D8。
context: column:M;spell:Gift of Alacrity;book:荒洲探险家指南;level:1
target: • You touch a willing creature. For the duration, it can add an extra D8 to its initiative rolls.
note: M85, 2014 Gift of Alacrity, Explorer's Guide to Wildemount source: optional extra D8 on initiative rolls retained, including the source die notation.

source:
• 你对触及范围内一个生物发动一次近战法术攻击。命中时，目标受到3d10点黯蚀伤害。
• 升环施法效应：使用2环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比1环高一环，伤害就增加1d10。
target:
• Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 Necrotic damage.
• Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.
note: M98, 2014 Inflict Wounds: retained melee spell attack within reach, hit gate, 3d10 and 1d10 scaling; no saving throw from another edition added.

source: • 你触碰一个生物，并使该生物的跳跃距离在法术持续时间内增至三倍。
target: • You touch a creature, tripling its jump distance for the duration.
note: M99, 2014 Jump: translated the complete short source, including the threefold jump distance and duration, without adding movement costs or a fixed jump distance.

source:
• 你触碰一个生物，该目标速度在法术持续时间内增加10尺。
• 升环施法效应：使用2环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比1环高一环，你就可以额外指定一个目标。
target:
• You touch a creature. Its speed increases by 10 feet for the duration.
• Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1.
note: M100, 2014 Longstrider: retained 10-foot speed increase, duration and one extra target per slot level above 1 with the level-2 threshold.

source: • 你触碰一个未着装护甲的自愿生物，使其受一个保护性魔法力场环绕直至法术终止。目标的基础AC变为13＋它的敏捷调整值。目标着装护甲或你以一个动作解散该法术后法术随之终止。
target: • You touch a willing creature that is not wearing armor, surrounding it with a protective magical force until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.
note: M101, 2014 Mage Armor: willingness, no-armor prerequisite, base AC formula and both ending conditions retained; dismissal still costs an action.

source: • 你指定施法距离内一点，净化指定点周围半径5尺球状区域内的非魔法饮食品，并驱除其浸染的所有毒素和疾病。
context: column:M;spell:Purify Food and Drink;book:玩家手册;level:1
target: • Choose a point within range. You purify the nonmagical food and drink in a sphere with a radius of 5 feet centered on that point, removing all poison and disease from it.
note: M105, 2014 Purify Food and Drink: retained nonmagical restriction, 5-foot-radius sphere and removal of all poison and disease.

source: • 一道看不见的法力护盾浮现在你身边，保护着你。在你的下一回合开始前，你的AC 具有+5加值（在触发该法术的攻击之前生效），并且不会受到魔法飞弹的伤害。
target: • An invisible shield of magical force appears around you and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, taking effect before the attack that triggered this spell, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.
note: M109, 2014 Shield: retained next-turn start, +5, the source's explicit before-triggering-attack timing and Magic Missile damage protection; no new trigger added.

source: • 围绕着施法距离内你指定的一个生物出现一片闪着微光的魔法力场。使目标在法术持续时间内AC获得+2加值。
target: • A shimmering magical force surrounds a creature you choose within range, granting the target a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.
note: M110, 2014 Shield of Faith: chosen creature within range, +2 AC and duration all retained.

source: • 你触碰一个自愿生物，并使目标的皮肤在法术终止前呈现粗糙的树皮状外观。期间目标无论着装何种护甲，其AC将不会降至16以下。
target: • You touch a willing creature, giving its skin a rough, bark-like appearance until the spell ends. During that time, its AC cannot fall below 16, regardless of what armor it wears.
note: M133, 2014 Barkskin: retained willingness, appearance, duration and AC floor of 16 independent of worn armor; did not substitute a later edition's AC.

source: • 你的身影变得模糊，并在别人眼里闪烁不定。在法术持续时间内，任何生物对你发动的攻击检定具有劣势。不依赖视觉（例如盲视）或可以看穿幻象（例如真实视觉）的攻击者免疫此效应。
target: • Your body becomes blurred, shifting and flickering in the eyes of others. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Attackers that do not rely on sight, such as those with Blindsight, or that can see through illusions, such as those with Truesight, are immune to this effect.
note: M136, 2014 Blur: retained all attack rolls, duration and both separate exceptions, including the Blindsight and Truesight examples.

source: • 你在所触碰物件上制造如火把一样亮的火焰，使其看上去与一般火焰无异，不过其并不会发热，也不需要燃烧氧气。你可以掩盖或隐藏它，但无法将之闷熄或扑灭。
target: • You create a flame as bright as a torch on an object you touch. It looks like an ordinary flame, but produces no heat and does not consume oxygen. You can cover or hide it, but cannot smother or extinguish it.
note: M140, 2014 Continual Flame: retained torch brightness, appearance, no heat or oxygen consumption, concealment permissions and the source's extinguishing restriction.

source: • 你触碰一个自愿的生物，并给予其在黑暗中视物的能力。在法术持续时间内，该生物将拥有60尺的黑暗视觉。
target: • You touch a willing creature, granting it the ability to see in darkness. For the duration, it has Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
note: M144, 2014 Darkvision: retained willing touch target and 60-foot Darkvision for the duration; no other range substituted.

source: • 你触碰一个生物，并终止正影响它的一项疾病或一种状态。该状态可以是目盲，耳聋，麻痹或中毒其一。
target: • You touch a creature and end one disease or one condition affecting it. The condition can be Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
note: M165, 2014 Lesser Restoration: one disease OR one of the four listed conditions retained; disease removal was not dropped to match a later edition.

source: • 你点名或描述一种野兽或植物，并专注于附近的自然之音。如果5里内存在该类生物，你将知晓其中最接近个体与你的相对方位和距离。
context: column:M;spell:Locate Animals or Plants;book:玩家手册;level:2
target: • You name or describe a kind of Beast or plant and focus on the sounds of nature nearby. If an individual of that kind is within 5 li, you learn the direction and distance to the nearest one.
note: M167, 2014 Locate Animals or Plants: retained naming/description, Beast-or-plant scope and nearest direction/distance. The source uses a generic individual/creature reference after both kinds; no extra category added. Bare li is deliberately unconverted.

source: • 你短暂地被银白的雾气所笼罩，传送到至多30尺内一个你能看见且未被占据的位置。
target: • Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
note: M175, 2014 Misty Step: retained up-to-30-foot distance, visibility and unoccupied destination.

source: • 你能在法术持续时间内看见任何隐形的生物和物件，如同其处于正常可见状态一样。你还能够看见以太位面，而以太位面的生物和物件在你眼中会以幽灵般的半透明状出现。
target: • For the duration, you can see invisible creatures and objects as though they were normally visible. You can also see into the Ethereal Plane; creatures and objects there appear ghostly and translucent to you.
note: M186, 2014 See Invisibility: translated both invisible creatures/objects and Ethereal Plane perception, including the ghostly translucent appearance.

source: • 你令你能看见的天空中的一个部分出现至多10个字。文字看起来是由云彩构成的，并在法术的持续时间内留在原位。文字将会在法术终结时消失。强风可以吹散云彩，令法术提前终止。
target: • You cause up to 10 characters to appear in a part of the sky you can see. The writing appears to be made of clouds and stays in place for the duration. It disappears when the spell ends. A strong wind can disperse the clouds, ending the spell early.
note: M190, 2014 Skywrite: the actual source says characters, not words, so the limit remains 10 characters. Retained visible sky, stationary cloud writing and early ending from strong wind; did not import another text's word limit.

source: • 你触碰一个自愿的生物，并使其在法术终止前能够在垂直表面上下或横向移动，其甚至可以在天花板上倒挂着移动而不需要用到双手。另外，目标获得与步行速度相等的攀爬速度。
target: • You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, it can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces, and even upside down along ceilings, without using its hands. The target also gains a Climb Speed equal to its walking speed.
note: M192, 2014 Spider Climb: retained willingness, all directions including ceilings, hands-free movement and Climb Speed equal to walking speed.

source: • 你从往昔的魂灵中获取知识。选择一项你没有熟练的技能。在法术的持续时间里，你拥有所选技能的熟练项。如果你再次释放该法术，该法术会提前结束。
context: column:M;spell:Borrowed Knowledge;book:斯翠海文：混乱之课;level:2
target: • You draw knowledge from spirits of the past. Choose a skill in which you lack proficiency. For the duration, you have proficiency in that skill. The spell ends early if you cast it again.
note: M207, 2014 Borrowed Knowledge, Strixhaven source: retained the nonproficient-skill prerequisite, duration and early ending on recasting.

source: • 你身上发出的治愈能量形成半径30尺的灵光。法术持续时间内灵光将以你为中心随你移动。你可以用一个附赠动作为灵光范围内的一名生物（包括你自己）恢复2d6的生命值。
target: • Healing energy radiates from you in an aura with a radius of 30 feet. For the duration, the aura stays centered on you and moves with you. You can use a Bonus Action to restore 2d6 hit points to one creature in the aura, including yourself.
note: M216, 2014 Aura of Vitality: retained 30-foot moving aura, Bonus Action, one creature including self and 2d6 healing; no automatic healing added.

source: • 该法术带来活力与希望。在施法距离内指定任意数量的生物，并使其在法术持续时间内进行的感知豁免和死亡豁免具有优势。此外，其获得治疗时均以骰子最大值来决定其恢复的生命值。
target: • This spell brings vitality and hope. Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, they have advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws. In addition, whenever they receive healing, use the maximum die results to determine the hit points they regain.
note: M217, 2014 Beacon of Hope: retained any number of targets, both save types, duration and the source's maximum-die-results healing rule.

source: • 神圣的能量自你身上发出并形成30尺半径的灵光，并为友方生物激励勇气。在法术持续时间内，灵光将以你为中心随你移动。灵光范围内的非敌对生物（包括你自己）的武器攻击命中时将额外造成1d4点光耀伤害。
target: • Holy energy radiates from you in an aura with a radius of 30 feet, inspiring courage in friendly creatures. For the duration, the aura stays centered on you and moves with you. Nonhostile creatures in the aura, including you, deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage when they hit with a weapon attack.
note: M228, 2014 Crusader's Mantle: retained moving 30-foot aura and the mechanical nonhostile-creature condition, including self, with weapon-hit gate and 1d4 Radiant damage.

source: • 受你触碰的一个自愿生物在法术持续时间内对下列你指定的一种伤害类型具有抗性：强酸、冷冻、火焰、闪电、雷鸣。
target: • For the duration, a willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type you choose from the following: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.
note: M257, 2014 Protection from Energy: retained willingness, touch, duration and exactly one choice from all five listed damage types.

source: • 你的触碰立即为一个生物或一个物件解除其身上的所有诅咒。如果目标物体是一件被诅咒的魔法物品则其上的诅咒不会因此解除，不过该法术可以打破诅咒物品与其所有者之间的同调，使其所有者可以将其卸下或丢弃。
target: • Your touch immediately ends all curses on a creature or an object. If the target is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner's attunement to it so the owner can remove or discard it.
note: M259, 2014 Remove Curse: retained all-curses removal and the cursed-magic-item exception; only attunement is broken for that exception, permitting removal or discard.

source: • 你触碰一个在前一分钟内刚刚死去的生物，使该生物以1点生命值重生。该法术不能复活老死的生物，也不能恢复失去的身体部位。
target: • You touch a creature that died within the last minute, returning it to life with 1 hit point. This spell cannot revive a creature that died of old age or restore missing body parts.
note: M260, 2014 Revivify: retained the last-minute requirement, 1 hit point and both old-age and missing-body-part limitations.

source: • 该法术赋予你所触碰生物听懂任何语言的能力。此外，当目标生物说话时，任何能听见其话语且掌握至少一门语言的生物都能听懂它的话。
target: • This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any language it hears. In addition, when the target speaks, any creature that can hear it and knows at least one language can understand what it says.
note: M276, 2014 Tongues: retained comprehension of heard languages and both listener prerequisites for understanding the target's speech; no reading ability added.

source: • 在法术终止前，该法术让施法距离内你能看见的至多十个自愿生物获得在水下呼吸的能力。此外，受术者依然保有正常的呼吸能力。
target: • Until the spell ends, up to ten willing creatures you can see within range gain the ability to breathe underwater. The recipients also retain their normal ability to breathe.
note: M280, 2014 Water Breathing: retained up to ten willing visible targets within range and their normal breathing; the source's written ten remains a word.

source: • 你或一个你触碰的生物变为隐形，直至法术终止。任何保持在目标身上的着装物和携带物也可以维持隐形状态。
target: • You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target wears or carries can also remain invisible as long as it stays on the target.
note: M313, 2014 source N is exactly Great Invisibility. Translated only the complete M body and retained the carried/worn-items staying-on-target condition. The unusual English name is recorded, not silently corrected to Greater Invisibility.

source: • 该法术使你触碰的一个自愿生物皮肤变得硬如岩石。目标在法术终止前对非魔法的钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害具有抗性。
target: • This spell makes the skin of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
note: M329, 2014 Stoneskin: retained willing touch target, duration and nonmagical restriction across all three damage types.

source: • 你传送至60尺内一处你可见且未被占据的空间。在法术结束之前你的每个回合，你都可以用附赠动作再次通过这个方法传送。
context: column:M;spell:Far Step;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:5
target: • You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet. On each of your turns before the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action to teleport in this way again.
note: M365, 2014 Far Step: retained visible unoccupied 60-foot destination and repeat Bonus Action teleportation on each turn; no extra per-cast movement added.

source: • 持握用于施法成分的那根权杖并触碰一个不超过大型、未被占据的座椅。水晶权杖消失，且这个座椅被转变为法驱魔舵 。
context: column:M;spell:Create Spelljamming Helm;book:星界冒险指南;level:5
target: • While holding the rod used as the spell's material component, touch an unoccupied chair no larger than Large. The crystal rod vanishes, and the chair is transformed into a spelljamming helm.
note: M403, 2014 Create Spelljamming Helm: retained holding the component rod, an unoccupied chair no larger than Large, consumption of the crystal rod and the resulting helm. No external item description added.

source: • 你触碰一个自愿的生物，让该法术赋予其看到事物真实面目的能力。受术者在法术持续时间内拥有120尺的真实视觉，其能发现被魔法隐藏的暗门，也能看到以太位面。
target: • You touch a willing creature, granting it the ability to see things as they truly are. For the duration, it has Truesight with a range of 120 feet, can notice secret doors hidden by magic, and can see into the Ethereal Plane.
note: M446, 2014 True Seeing: retained willing touch target, 120-foot Truesight, magically hidden secret doors and Ethereal Plane sight; no additional scope restriction imported.

source: • 直至法术终止前，你每次进行魅力检定时可以用15代替你掷出的数值。此外，无论你说什么，判断你是否说谎的魔法都会将你的话视为真实。
target: • Until the spell ends, whenever you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you rolled with 15. In addition, no matter what you say, magic that determines whether you are lying treats your words as truthful.
note: M490, 2014 Glibness: retained optional replacement with 15 for every Charisma check and truth-detection treatment; did not change it into a minimum-roll rule.

source: • 你免疫所有伤害直到法术结束。
target: • You are immune to all damage until the spell ends.
note: M508, 2014 Invulnerability: complete short source translated; no other defenses or conditions inferred from the spell name.

source: • 你读出一威力满溢的单词，其足以使施法距离内一个你能看见的生物立即死亡。如果你所指定的生物现有生命值为100或更少，则其立即死亡。否则该法术不产生任何效应。
target: • You utter a word filled with power, enough to instantly kill a creature you can see within range. If the chosen creature has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies instantly. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.
note: M513, 2014 Power Word Kill: retained visible target within range, inclusive 100-hit-point threshold, immediate death and no effect above the threshold; no saving throw or fallback damage added.
